jobs.title: Packaging Development Engineer
jobs.description:
At Straumann Group we’re on an exciting journey of growth, innovation, and impact - driven by our mission to improve oral health and transform millions of lives worldwide. United by purpose, we bring our best selves to work every day, embracing a high-performance, player-learner culture that inspires collaboration, curiosity, and ambition. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to take charge of your own career, harnessing your skills, passion, and enthusiasm for learning to continually grow and progress. Together, we’re not just shaping brighter smiles, we’re unlocking the potential of people everywhere, including our own.

Packaging plays a critical role in ensuring the safety, integrity, and usability of our medical devices throughout the entire product lifecycle. Beyond protecting the product, packaging must comply with global regulatory requirements, enable efficient manufacturing and logistics, support sustainability ambitions, and deliver excellent customer experience.
We are looking for an experienced and collaborative Packaging Development Engineer to join our Global Packaging team at Straumann Group Headquarters in Basel.
In this role, you will take ownership of complex packaging development and Life Cycle Management (LCM) initiatives across our global product portfolio. You will lead technical packaging projects from concept through implementation, working closely with colleagues from Research & Development, Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Affairs, Procurement, Marketing, and external suppliers.
You will apply and further develop your packaging engineering expertise while working on new product developments as well as the optimization, transfer, and continuous improvement of existing products across our global manufacturing network. You will be part of an experienced packaging team where technical collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning are an important part of how we work.

This position offers the opportunity to build strong expertise in medical device packaging, take increasing ownership of challenging engineering projects, and contribute to the continued development of packaging solutions within Straumann Group. The role reports to the Head of Packaging, LCM SDIS & RDI Academy, is based at the company's headquarters in Basel, Switzerland, and requires moderate international travel.


• Your responsibilities:

  • Develop packaging solutions for existing and new products from concept through implementation, considering product, regulatory, manufacturing, sustainability, and customer requirements.
  • Take ownership of assigned packaging development and Life Cycle Management (LCM) projects and activities.
  • Collaborate with global cross-functional teams, including Engineering, Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Affairs, Procurement, and Marketing.
  • Translate technical and user requirements into robust, practical, and cost-effective packaging solutions.
  • Manage packaging development activities, including project planning, risk assessment, timeline management, technical documentation, and stakeholder communication.
  • Conduct feasibility assessments, engineering evaluations, and cost analyses to support packaging design decisions and identify suitable technical solutions.
  • Plan, coordinate, and evaluate packaging verification and validation activities, including transportation testing, shelf-life studies, sterile barrier validation, and compatibility testing.
  • Support packaging activities related to global product transfers, manufacturing site localization, supplier changes, business continuity, and Life Cycle Management initiatives.
  • Collaborate with suppliers and external development partners to evaluate and implement packaging materials, technologies, components, and manufacturing processes.
  • Create, maintain, and improve packaging specifications, technical drawings, engineering documentation, design guidelines, and related standards.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives to optimize packaging design, materials, manufacturing processes, sustainability, and cost.
  • Support the evaluation of new packaging technologies, materials, industry standards, and sustainability developments and contribute to their practical implementation where appropriate.
  • Support packaging-related activities during internal and external audits, inspections, and regulatory assessments.
  • Share technical knowledge within the team and actively contribute to a collaborative learning environment.
  • Build and maintain strong collaborative relationships with global stakeholders, manufacturing sites, suppliers, and packaging experts throughout the Straumann Group.

Your • Profile - • Qualifications

• Requirements needed
• Bachelor's or master’s degree in Packaging Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
Experience (with key words)
• Typically, 2–5 years of relevant experience in packaging development, packaging engineering, product development, or a related technical field.
• Hands-on experience with technical packaging development projects and working in cross-functional teams.
• Good understanding of packaging materials, packaging technologies, manufacturing processes, and packaging test methodologies.
• Experience in medical devices, pharmaceuticals, or another regulated industry is an advantage. Candidates from other technically demanding packaging environments with a strong interest in medical device packaging are also encouraged to apply.
• Ability to plan and coordinate technical activities, manage priorities, and deliver agreed results within project timelines.
• Basic understanding of regulatory requirements, industry standards, and structured product development processes. Knowledge of standards such as ISO 11607, ASTM, ISTA, MDR, or FDA requirements is an advantage.
• Knowledge of sterile packaging systems, sealing technologies, and sterilization processes is an advantage and can be further developed within the role.
• Experience with packaging verification and validation activities and related test methods such as transportation testing, seal strength, dye penetration, bubble emission, or visual inspection is an advantage.
• Understanding Design Control processes, particularly within medical device development, is an advantage.
• Experience applying engineering tools such as risk management, technical drawings, statistical analysis, material evaluation, or structured problem-solving.
• Ability to identify improvement opportunities and contribute to packaging solutions that enhance product performance, manufacturing efficiency, sustainability, robustness, or cost competitiveness.


Personal Attributes
• Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Collaborative team player with excellent interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to build trusted relationships across functions, cultures, and global organizations.
• Takes ownership, makes sound engineering decisions, and delivers pragmatic solutions.
• Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to explain technical topics to different audiences.
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken; additional languages are an advantage.
• Curious, proactive, and motivated by continuous learning and technical excellence.
• Comfortable working in a dynamic international environment with changing priorities.
• Demonstrates integrity, accountability, and a strong commitment to quality and patient safety.
• Embraces Straumann Group's Mission, Values, and collaborative culture.
• Demonstrates a "Player-Learner" mindset: communicates openly, welcomes feedback, continuously develops expertise, and actively contributes to the success of the team.

This position is based at our headquarters in Basel and involves a hybrid work arrangement, with in-office work at least three times a week.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

Unito di proposito, portiamo i nostri migliori se stessi a lavorare ogni giorno, abbracciando una cultura ad alte prestazioni, player-learner che ispira collaborazione, curiosità e ambizione. Qui, avrete l’opportunità di prendere in carico la vostra carriera, sfruttando le vostre abilità, passione e entusiasmo per imparare a crescere e progredire continuamente. Insieme, non stiamo solo modellando sorrisi più brillanti, stiamo sbloccando il potenziale delle persone ovunque, compreso il nostro. L'imballaggio svolge un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire la sicurezza, l'integrità e l'usabilità dei nostri dispositivi medici durante tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto. Oltre a proteggere il prodotto, l'imballaggio deve rispettare i requisiti normativi globali, consentire una produzione efficiente e logistica, sostenere le ambizioni di sostenibilità, e fornire un'eccellente esperienza del cliente. Siamo alla ricerca di un esperto e collaborativo Packaging Development Engineer per unire il nostro Global Packaging team alla sede del Gruppo Straumann a Basilea. In questo ruolo, prenderete la proprietà di complesse iniziative di sviluppo del packaging e Life Cycle Management (LCM) nel nostro portafoglio prodotti globale. Condurrai progetti di packaging tecnico dal concetto attraverso l'implementazione, lavorando a stretto contatto con colleghi di Ricerca & Sviluppo, Operazioni, Qualità, Affari Regolatori, Affari Clinici, Procurement, Marketing e fornitori esterni. In qualità di esperto tecnico, contribuirai all'evoluzione delle nostre piattaforme di confezionamento, degli standard di ingegneria e dei processi di sviluppo, supportando al contempo il trasferimento, l'ottimizzazione e il miglioramento continuo dei prodotti esistenti in tutta la nostra rete di produzione globale. Questa posizione offre l'opportunità di influenzare la strategia di imballaggio, guidare l'innovazione e modellare il futuro dell'imballaggio di dispositivi medici all'interno del Gruppo Straumann. Il ruolo del responsabile dell'imballaggio, LCM SDIS & RDI Academy, si basa sulla sede dell'azienda a Basilea, in Svizzera, e richiede viaggi internazionali moderati. • Le vostre responsabilità: Progetti di sviluppo di imballaggi complessi e Life Cycle Management (LCM), dal concept all'implementazione, per prodotti nuovi e esistenti. Progettazione di soluzioni innovative, robuste e convenienti per l'imballaggio che soddisfano i requisiti di prodotto, produzione, regolazione, qualità e cliente. > Guidare decisioni tecniche per le complesse sfide di confezionamento in più famiglie di prodotti. Gestisci i progetti di sviluppo dell'imballaggio, tra cui pianificazione, tempestività, valutazione del rischio, coordinamento delle risorse e comunicazione degli stakeholder. Leader attività di packaging che supportano trasferimenti globali di prodotti, localizzazione dei siti produttivi, cambiamenti dei fornitori e iniziative di continuità aziendale. < > > Pianificare, coordinare e valutare le attività di verifica e validazione del packaging, tra cui test di trasporto, studi di scaffalatura, convalida della barriera sterile e test di compatibilità. Condurre studi di fattibilità, valutazioni ingegneristiche e analisi dei costi per identificare soluzioni di imballaggio ottimali che bilanciano qualità, conformità, manufacturability, sostenibilità e costo totale di proprietà. Fornire leadership tecnica in team multifunzionali globali, collaborando con Engineering, Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Affairs, Procurement e Marketing. Collabora con fornitori e partner esterni per identificare, qualificare e implementare materiali innovativi di imballaggio, tecnologie e processi produttivi. Costruire forti relazioni collaborative con le parti interessate globali, i siti di produzione, i fornitori e gli esperti di packaging del Gruppo Straumann. Definire, migliorare e mantenere standard di ingegneria di imballaggio globali, linee guida di progettazione, specifiche e best practice. Promuovere iniziative di miglioramento continuo per ottimizzare la progettazione, i materiali, i processi produttivi e le prestazioni ambientali. Monitorare le tecnologie emergenti, gli sviluppi normativi, le tendenze di sostenibilità e gli standard del settore, traducerle in soluzioni di ingegneria pratica. I colleghi di mentori, condividono le competenze tecniche e contribuiscono allo sviluppo continuo delle capacità di confezionamento in tutta l'organizzazione. Il tuo • Profilo - • Qualifiche

< < > < > ιstrong> Istruzione
• Esperienza di progetti tecnici leader in ambienti interfunzionali e internazionali. * Buona conoscenza dei materiali di imballaggio, tecnologie di imballaggio, processi di produzione e metodologie di test di imballaggio.
• Conoscenza dei processi di sviluppo dei dispositivi medici con una buona comprensione dei flussi di lavoro dei prodotti e degli utenti.
• Esperienza nella gestione del progetto con la capacità di gestire più priorità e fornire risultati entro tempi concordati.
• Comprensione dei requisiti normativi e degli standard del settore relativi al confezionamento di dispositivi medici, tra cui ISO, ASTM, ISTA, MDR, FDA e requisiti di sostenibilità.
• Conoscenza dei sistemi di imballaggio sterili, tecnologie di sigillatura e processi di sterilizzazione.
• L'esperienza con la convalida del sistema di barriera sterile e i relativi metodi di prova (ad esempio, la forza di tenuta, la penetrazione della tintura, l'emissione della bolla, l'ispezione visiva) è considerato un vantaggio. * Buona comprensione dei processi di Design Control per dispositivi medici.
• Esperienza nell'applicazione di strumenti di ingegneria come la gestione del rischio, disegni tecnici, analisi statistica e valutazione delle prestazioni materiali.
• Capacità comprovata di individuare le opportunità per l’innovazione e implementare i miglioramenti degli imballaggi che migliorano le prestazioni del prodotto, l’efficienza produttiva, la sostenibilità o la competitività dei costi Apporta la proprietà, prende decisioni di ingegneria sonora e offre soluzioni pragmatiche. Dimostra l'integrità, la responsabilità e un forte impegno per la qualità e la sicurezza dei pazienti.
• Embraces Straumann Group's Mission, Valori e cultura collaborativa. Tutti i candidati qualificati riceveranno considerazione per l'occupazione senza riguardo a razza, colore, religione, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, origine nazionale o disabilità.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei der Straumann Group befinden wir uns auf einer aufregenden Reise des Wachstums, der Innovation und der Wirkung - angetrieben von unserer Mission, die Mundgesundheit zu verbessern und Millionen von Leben weltweit zu verändern. Gemeinsam bringen wir unser bestes Selbst jeden Tag zur Arbeit und nutzen eine leistungsstarke Spieler-Lernkultur, die Zusammenarbeit, Neugier und Ehrgeiz inspiriert. Hier haben Sie die Möglichkeit, Ihre eigene Karriere zu übernehmen und Ihre Fähigkeiten, Leidenschaft und Begeisterung für das Lernen zu nutzen, um kontinuierlich zu wachsen und sich weiterzuentwickeln. Gemeinsam formen wir nicht nur ein helleres Lächeln, wir erschließen das Potenzial von Menschen überall, einschließlich unseres eigenen.

Verpackungen spielen eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Gewährleistung der Sicherheit, Integrität und Nutzbarkeit unserer Medizinprodukte während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus. Über den Schutz des Produkts hinaus müssen Verpackungen globale regulatorische Anforderungen erfüllen, eine effiziente Herstellung und Logistik ermöglichen, Nachhaltigkeitsziele unterstützen und ein hervorragendes Kundenerlebnis bieten. Wir suchen einen erfahrenen und kooperativen Verpackungsentwicklungsingenieur, der sich unserem globalen Verpackungsteam am Hauptsitz der Straumann-Gruppe in Basel anschließt.
In dieser Funktion übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für komplexe Verpackungsentwicklung und Life Cycle Management (LCM)-Initiativen in unserem globalen Produktportfolio. Sie leiten technische Verpackungsprojekte vom Konzept bis zur Umsetzung und arbeiten eng mit Kollegen aus Forschung & Entwicklung, Betrieb, Qualität, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Affairs, Beschaffung, Marketing und externen Lieferanten zusammen.
Als technischer Experte tragen Sie zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Verpackungsplattformen, Engineering-Standards und Entwicklungsprozesse bei und unterstützen gleichzeitig den erfolgreichen Transfer, die Optimierung und die kontinuierliche Verbesserung bestehender Produkte in unserem globalen Fertigungsnetzwerk. Diese Position bietet die Möglichkeit, die Verpackungsstrategie zu beeinflussen, Innovationen voranzutreiben und die Zukunft der Medizinprodukteverpackung innerhalb der Straumann Group zu gestalten. Die Rolle berichtet an den Head of Packaging, LCM SDIS & RDI Academy, mit Sitz in Basel, Schweiz, und erfordert moderate internationale Reisen.


• Ihre Aufgaben:

  • Führen Sie komplexe Verpackungsentwicklungs- und Life Cycle Management-Projekte (LCM) von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung für neue und bestehende Produkte.
  • Entwerfen Sie innovative, robuste und kostengünstige Verpackungslösungen, die die Produkt-, Fertigungs-, Regulierungs-, Qualitäts- und Kundenanforderungen erfüllen.
  • Technische Entscheidungen für komplexe Verpackungsherausforderungen über mehrere Produktfamilien hinweg vorantreiben.

Project & Technical Leadership

  • Verwalten Sie Verpackungsentwicklungsprojekte, einschließlich Planung, Zeitpläne, Risikobewertung, Ressourcenkoordination und Stakeholderkommunikation.
  • Leitende Verpackungsaktivitäten, die globale Produkttransfers, die Lokalisierung von Fertigungsstandorten, Lieferantenwechsel und Initiativen zur Geschäftskontinuität unterstützen.
  • Planen, koordinieren und bewerten Sie die Überprüfung und Validierung von Verpackungen, einschließlich Transporttests, Haltbarkeitsstudien, Validierung von Sterilbarrieren und Kompatibilitätstests.
  • Machbarkeitsstudien, technische Bewertungen und Kostenanalysen durchführen, um optimale Verpackungslösungen zu identifizieren, die Qualität, Compliance, Herstellbarkeit, Nachhaltigkeit und Gesamtbetriebskosten in Einklang bringen.


Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Bieten Sie eine technische Führungsrolle in globalen cross-funktionalen Teams und arbeiten Sie mit Engineering, Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Affairs, Procurement und Marketing zusammen.
  • Arbeiten Sie mit Lieferanten und externen Partnern zusammen, um innovative Verpackungsmaterialien, Technologien und Herstellungsverfahren zu identifizieren, zu qualifizieren und umzusetzen.
  • Aufbau starker Kooperationsbeziehungen mit globalen Stakeholdern, Produktionsstätten, Lieferanten und Verpackungsexperten in der Straumann-Gruppe.


Standards, Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Definieren, verbessern und pflegen Sie globale Standards für Verpackungstechnik, Designrichtlinien, Spezifikationen und Best Practices.
  • Förderung kontinuierlicher Verbesserungsinitiativen zur Optimierung von Verpackungsdesign, Materialien, Herstellungsprozessen und Umweltleistung.
  • Überwachen Sie aufkommende Technologien, regulatorische Entwicklungen, Nachhaltigkeitstrends und Industriestandards und übersetzen Sie sie in praktische Engineering-Lösungen.


Expertise & Knowledge Sharing

  • Agieren Sie als Subject Matter Expert (KMU) für Verpackungsthemen bei internen und externen Audits, Inspektionen und regulatorischen Bewertungen.
  • Mentor-Kollegen, teilen technisches Know-how und tragen zur kontinuierlichen Entwicklung der Verpackungstechnik im gesamten Unternehmen bei.


Ihr • Profil - • Qualifikationen

Education

• Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Verpackungsentwicklung, der Entwicklung von Medizinprodukten oder einer anderen regulierten Industrie.
• Erleben Sie führende technische Projekte in funktionsübergreifenden und internationalen Umgebungen.
Gute Kenntnisse über Verpackungsmaterialien, Verpackungstechnologien, Herstellungsverfahren und Verpackungsprüfmethoden.
• Kenntnis der Entwicklungsprozesse von Medizinprodukten mit einem guten Verständnis der Produkt- und Benutzer-Workflows.
• Erfahrung im Projektmanagement mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten zu verwalten und Ergebnisse innerhalb vereinbarter Zeitpläne zu liefern.
• Verständnis von regulatorischen Anforderungen und Industriestandards in Bezug auf Medizinprodukteverpackungen, einschließlich ISO, ASTM, ISTA, MDR, FDA und Nachhaltigkeitsanforderungen.
• Kenntnisse über sterile Verpackungssysteme, Dichtungstechnologien und Sterilisationsprozesse.
• Erfahrungen mit der Validierung von Sterilbarrierensystemen und verwandten Testmethoden (z. B. Siegelfestigkeit, Farbstoffdurchdringung, Blasenemission, visuelle Inspektion) werden als Vorteil angesehen.
Gutes Verständnis der Design Control Prozesse für medizinische Geräte.
• Erfahrung in der Anwendung von Engineering-Tools wie Risikomanagement, technischen Zeichnungen, statistischer Analyse und Materialleistungsbewertung.
• Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Innovationsmöglichkeiten zu erkennen und Verpackungsverbesserungen zu implementieren, die die Produktleistung, die Fertigungseffizienz, die Nachhaltigkeit oder die Wettbewerbsfähigkeit der Kosten verbessern

Persönliche Eigenschaften

• Starkes analytisches Denken und strukturierte Problemlösungskompetenzen mit exzellenter Liebe zum Detail.
• Teamplayer mit hervorragenden zwischenmenschlichen und Stakeholder-Managementfähigkeiten.
• Fähigkeit, vertrauenswürdige Beziehungen zwischen Funktionen, Kulturen und globalen Organisationen aufzubauen.
• Übernimmt Verantwortung, trifft fundierte technische Entscheidungen und liefert pragmatische Lösungen.
• Starke Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, technische Themen verschiedenen Zielgruppen zu erklären.
•Fließend Englisch, sowohl geschrieben als auch gesprochen; zusätzliche Sprachen sind von Vorteil.
• Neugierig, proaktiv und motiviert durch kontinuierliches Lernen und technische Exzellenz.
• Komfortables Arbeiten in einem dynamischen internationalen Umfeld mit wechselnden Prioritäten.
• Zeigt Integrität, Rechenschaftspflicht und ein starkes Engagement für Qualität und Patientensicherheit.
• Begreift Mission, Werte und Kooperationskultur der Straumann Group.
• Zeigt eine "Player-Learner"-Mentalität: kommuniziert offen, begrüßt Feedback, entwickelt kontinuierlich Know-how und trägt aktiv zum Erfolg des Teams bei.

Alle qualifizierten Bewerber erhalten eine Gegenleistung für eine Beschäftigung ohne Rücksicht auf Rasse, Hautfarbe, Religion, Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität, nationale Herkunft oder Behinderung.

Chez Straumann Group, nous sommes sur un parcours passionnant de croissance, d'innovation et d'impact, animé par notre mission d'améliorer la santé buccodentaire et de transformer des millions de vies dans le monde entier. Unis par le but, nous apportons nos meilleurs nous-mêmes au travail chaque jour, embrassant une culture de haute performance, joueur-learner qui inspire la collaboration, la curiosité et l'ambition. Ici, vous aurez l'occasion de prendre en charge votre propre carrière, d'exploiter vos compétences, votre passion et votre enthousiasme pour apprendre à croître et à progresser continuellement. Ensemble, nous ne formons pas seulement des sourires plus brillants, nous débloquons le potentiel des gens partout, y compris le nôtre.

L'emballage joue un rôle essentiel pour assurer la sécurité, l'intégrité et la convivialité de nos appareils médicaux tout au long du cycle de vie du produit. En plus de protéger le produit, l'emballage doit respecter les exigences réglementaires mondiales, permettre une fabrication et une logistique efficaces, soutenir les ambitions de durabilité et fournir une excellente expérience client.
Nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur de développement d'emballage expérimenté et collaboratif pour rejoindre notre équipe Global Packaging au siège du Groupe Stroumann à Bâle.
Dans ce rôle, vous prendrez en charge des initiatives complexes de développement d'emballage et de gestion du cycle de vie (LCM) dans notre portefeuille mondial de produits. Vous dirigerez des projets d'emballage technique depuis le concept jusqu'à la mise en oeuvre, en collaboration étroite avec des collègues de Recherche et Développement, Opérations, Qualité, Affaires réglementaires, Affaires cliniques, Approvisionnement, Marketing et fournisseurs externes.
En tant qu'expert technique, vous contribuerez à l'évolution de nos plateformes d'emballage, de nos normes d'ingénierie et de nos processus de développement tout en soutenant le transfert réussi, l'optimisation et l'amélioration continue des produits existants dans notre réseau mondial de fabrication.
Cette position offre l'occasion d'influencer la stratégie d'emballage, de stimuler l'innovation et de façonner l'avenir de l'emballage des dispositifs médicaux au sein du Groupe Stroumann. Le rôle relève du responsable de Packaging, LCM SDIS & RDI Academy, est basé au siège social de l'entreprise à Bâle, en Suisse, et nécessite des voyages internationaux modérés.


• Vos responsabilités :

  • Diriger les projets complexes d'élaboration d'emballages et de gestion du cycle de vie, du concept à la mise en oeuvre, pour les produits nouveaux et existants.
  • Concevoir des solutions d'emballage innovantes, robustes et rentables qui répondent aux exigences du produit, de la fabrication, de la réglementation, de la qualité et du client.
  • Conduire des décisions techniques pour les problèmes complexes d'emballage dans plusieurs familles de produits.

Projet et leadership technique

  • Gérer les projets d'élaboration d'emballages, y compris la planification, les échéanciers, l'évaluation des risques, la coordination des ressources et la communication avec les intervenants. Les activités d'emballage de pointe appuient les transferts mondiaux de produits, la localisation des sites de fabrication, les changements de fournisseurs et les initiatives de continuité des activités. Les résultats de l'enquête sont présentés dans le tableau ci-dessous. Planifier, coordonner et évaluer les activités de vérification et de validation des emballages, y compris les essais de transport, les études de durée de conservation, la validation des barrières stériles et les essais de compatibilité.
  • Mener des études de faisabilité, des évaluations techniques et des analyses de coûts afin de déterminer des solutions d'emballage optimales permettant d'équilibrer la qualité, la conformité, la fabrication, la durabilité et le coût total de la propriété.


Coopération avec les fonctions de l'emballage

  • Assurer le leadership technique des équipes interfonctionnelles à l'échelle mondiale, en partenariat avec le génie, les opérations, la qualité, les affaires réglementaires, les affaires cliniques, l'approvisionnement et la commercialisation.
  • Collaborer avec les fournisseurs et les partenaires externes pour déterminer, qualifier et mettre en oeuvre des matériaux d'emballage, des technologies et des procédés de fabrication novateurs.
    • Établir de solides relations de collaboration avec les intervenants mondiaux, les sites de fabrication, les fournisseurs et les experts en matière d'emballage dans l'ensemble du Groupe de Stroumann.


Normes, innovation et amélioration continue

  • Définir, améliorer et maintenir les normes mondiales d'ingénierie de l'emballage, les lignes directrices, les spécifications et les pratiques exemplaires. Mener des initiatives d'amélioration continue pour optimiser la conception des emballages, les matériaux, les procédés de fabrication et la performance environnementale.
  • Surveiller les nouvelles technologies, les développements réglementaires, les tendances en matière de durabilité et les normes de l'industrie, en les traduisant en solutions pratiques d'ingénierie.


Expertise et partage des connaissances

  • Associer l'expert en matière d'emballage aux vérifications internes et externes, aux inspections et aux évaluations réglementaires.
  • Des collègues de mentor, partagent leur expertise technique et contribuent au développement continu des capacités de génie de l'emballage dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.


Votre • Profil - • Qualifications

Éducation

• Minimum de 3 ans d'expérience dans le développement d'emballages, le développement d'instruments médicaux ou une autre industrie réglementée.

• Bonne compréhension des processus de contrôle de conception pour les dispositifs médicaux.

• Capacité d'établir des relations de confiance entre les fonctions, les cultures et les organisations mondiales.
• Prise en charge, prise de bonnes décisions d'ingénierie et offre des solutions pragmatiques.
• Fortes compétences en communication et en présentation avec la capacité d'expliquer des sujets techniques à différents publics.

• Curieux, proactif et motivé par l'apprentissage continu et l'excellence technique.

• Démontrer l'intégrité, la responsabilité et un engagement ferme envers la qualité et la sécurité des patients.

Die Straumann Gruppe zählt seit mehr als 70 Jahren zu den innovativsten Unternehmen der Schweiz. Unsere Mitarbeitenden setzen sich täglich dafür ein, die Zahnmedizin weiterzuentwickeln. Wir entwickeln, fertigen und liefern Zahnimplantate, CAD/CAM-Prothetik und Biomaterialien, die weltweit Menschen zu einem besseren Lebensgefühl verhelfen. In über 100 Ländern arbeiten wir gemeinsam an neuen, zukunftsweisenden Lösungen und verbinden dabei Technologie, Innovation und Teamarbeit.

An unserem Hauptsitz im Jacob-Burckhardt-Gebäude direkt beim Bahnhof SBB in Basel bilden wir aktuell 11 Lernende in 6 verschiedenen Berufen aus. Deine Lehre startest du an unserem Standort in Basel. Nach der Eröffnung unseres neuen Technologie- und Innovationszentrums in Arlesheim wirst du deine Ausbildung in einer hochmodernen Arbeitsumgebung fortsetzen. Bei uns übernimmst du früh Verantwortung und kannst eigene kleinere Projekte selbstständig umsetzen. Deine Ideen und deine Arbeiten werden nicht nur im Team geschätzt, sondern können auch innerhalb des Unternehmens oder extern präsentiert und ausgestellt werden.

  • Persönliche und kompetente Betreuung durch erfahrene Berufs- und Praxisbildende

  • Austausch und gemeinsame Aktivitäten mit anderen Lernenden

  • Ein internationales Arbeitsumfeld mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus aller Welt

jobs.description:
About the role:

The FM and Workplace Project Manager is responsible for the operational management of Real Estate, FM and Workplace related projects for the Straumann Campus in Basel (UPTOWN). The position is also actively involved in Health, Safety & Employee Wellbeing and site security for Basel (later Arlesheim, Uptown). The role establishes an attractive, sustainable, and compliant workplace environment while supporting business growth, employee experience and wellbeing, operational resilience, and cost optimization.

Key • Responsibilities:

Workplace Management

  • Manage office expansions, consolidations, relocations, and workplace transformation projects in Uptown.
  • Manage all project phases from planning and design through execution and occupancy.
  • Serve as liaison with landlords, architects, contractors, consultants, and internal stakeholders.
  • Develop workplace strategies that support hybrid work models, employee engagement and wellbeing, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Conduct space and occupancy analyses and o planning (digital / FMS) to optimize utilization and adjust to customer needs
  • Oversee lease administration, contract management, accruals, and asset management.
  • Ensure business continuity through effective transition and swing-space planning.
  • Maintain compliance with all authority and governance requirements.

FM & Office Construction Management

  • Lead construction and fit-out projects for the Uptown and Basel Campus.
  • Manage budgets, timelines, procurement processes, and contractor performance.
  • Coordinate tendering and RFP processes for external service providers.
  • Monitor project execution, quality standards, workplace design guidelines, and HSE requirements.
  • Ensure successful project handover and user adoption through change management initiatives.
  • Support FM hard services, write FM operations concept and house regulations for respective areas
  • On-call duty as required

Close interaction with FM Soft Services and Event Management Health, Safety & Employee Wellbeing

  • Support workplace health, safety, and wellbeing programs.
  • Coordinate emergency drills, safety campaigns, and employee wellness initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with occupational health and safety standards and regulations.
  • Promote a culture of safety, wellbeing, and continuous improvement.

Security Management

  • Serve as back up for Site Security Lead and on-call services (as required)
  • Manage physical security systems, access control, visitor management, and emergency response procedures.

• Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's/ KV or equivalent education in Facility Management, Business / Hospitality Services or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in workplace management, facility / real estate management, or related disciplines.
  • Proven experience leading FM and/or project teams and workplace projects.
  • Experience in Security and FM (hard & soft), external vendor management.
  • Strong understanding of lease administration, project management, and workplace strategy, FMS solutions
  • Familiarity with HSE, business continuity, and crisis management practices.

Key Competencies

  • Project & Change Management
  • Service Orientation
  • Leadership of Projects and Teams
  • Pragmatic Problem Solving & Decision Making
  • Communication & Presentation Skills
  • German, English required, other languages advantageous

Success Measures

  • Delivery of projects on time and within budget.
  • Optimization of workplace costs and space utilization.
  • High levels of workplace satisfaction and employee experience.
  • Strong safety, security, and compliance performance.
  • Effective vendor, customer and stakeholder management.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

Alternative Locations: Switzerland : Basel

About the role:

The FM and Workplace Project Manager is responsible for the operational management of Real Estate, FM and Workplace related projects for the Straumann Campus in Basel (UPTOWN). The position is also actively involved in Health, Safety & Employee Wellbeing and site security for Basel (later Arlesheim, Uptown). The role establishes an attractive, sustainable, and compliant workplace environment while supporting business growth, employee experience and wellbeing, operational resilience, and cost optimization.

Key • Responsibilities:

Workplace Management

  • Manage office expansions, consolidations, relocations, and workplace transformation projects in Uptown.
  • Manage all project phases from planning and design through execution and occupancy.
  • Serve as liaison with landlords, architects, contractors, consultants, and internal stakeholders.
  • Develop workplace strategies that support hybrid work models, employee engagement and wellbeing, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Conduct space and occupancy analyses and o planning (digital / FMS) to optimize utilization and adjust to customer needs
  • Oversee lease administration, contract management, accruals, and asset management.
  • Ensure business continuity through effective transition and swing-space planning.
  • Maintain compliance with all authority and governance requirements.

FM & Office Construction Management

  • Lead construction and fit-out projects for the Uptown and Basel Campus.
  • Manage budgets, timelines, procurement processes, and contractor performance.
  • Coordinate tendering and RFP processes for external service providers.
  • Monitor project execution, quality standards, workplace design guidelines, and HSE requirements.
  • Ensure successful project handover and user adoption through change management initiatives.
  • Support FM hard services, write FM operations concept and house regulations for respective areas
  • On-call duty as required

Close interaction with FM Soft Services and Event Management Health, Safety & Employee Wellbeing

  • Support workplace health, safety, and wellbeing programs.
  • Coordinate emergency drills, safety campaigns, and employee wellness initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with occupational health and safety standards and regulations.
  • Promote a culture of safety, wellbeing, and continuous improvement.

Security Management

  • Serve as back up for Site Security Lead and on-call services (as required)
  • Manage physical security systems, access control, visitor management, and emergency response procedures.

• Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's/ KV or equivalent education in Facility Management, Business / Hospitality Services or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in workplace management, facility / real estate management, or related disciplines.
  • Proven experience leading FM and/or project teams and workplace projects.
  • Experience in Security and FM (hard & soft), external vendor management.
  • Strong understanding of lease administration, project management, and workplace strategy, FMS solutions
  • Familiarity with HSE, business continuity, and crisis management practices.

Key Competencies

  • Project & Change Management
  • Service Orientation
  • Leadership of Projects and Teams
  • Pragmatic Problem Solving & Decision Making
  • Communication & Presentation Skills
  • German, English required, other languages advantageous

Success Measures

  • Delivery of projects on time and within budget.
  • Optimization of workplace costs and space utilization.
  • High levels of workplace satisfaction and employee experience.
  • Strong safety, security, and compliance performance.
  • Effective vendor, customer and stakeholder management.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

Employment Type: Full Time

Alternative Locations: Switzerland : Basel

Travel Percentage: 0 - 10%

Requisition ID: 21464
